Checking…
Stored only in this browser and sent straight to OpenAI. Anyone with access to this machine can read it, so use a key scoped to this project and rotate it if you share the laptop. A key pasted here renders photographs only; writing the concepts needs the key in the server.
No key is required. Without one the Studio writes concepts from your brand rules and uses the supplied reference imagery first. Final image approval remains a human check.
